structuredPlaybackWindow.state: all samples playing + depthState=ready + valid=true + stereo=true

rates.note: Depth Hz is NPU sampling; it is not display refresh or video frame rate.

snapshotStatistics.definition: Mean and P95 are calculated across 1182 one-second-ish diagnostic snapshots; they are not a sum of pipeline stages.

pairedVideoLagMs.definition: Latest decoded video PTS minus the video PTS in the accepted video/depth pair; this is not optical latency.

displayAgeMs.definition: Age field reported by the player diagnostics.

gpuLiquidTimer.reason: The timer does not reliably cover the complete liquid compute and completion path; the spread between near-zero values and multi-millisecond outliers is inconsistent with the full GPU pass. Do not use it as the liquid stage cost.

thermalAndPower.powerConclusion: No power conclusion; the run was charged and no power meter was used.

measurementBoundaries: The structured playback log covers about 20 minutes, just under 1200 seconds; it is not a 30-minute run.
The SurfaceFlinger collector covers about 580 seconds and uses a rolling history with overlapping rows; see presentation-summary.json.
A zero depthPtsLag means the accepted pair has matching media PTS in this instrument, not zero end-to-end delay.
The GPU and NPU timing fields are independent snapshots. They must not be added as if they were serial stages.
